jobs.title: Dutch Speaking Google Ads Account Manager (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Workplace:
Barcelona, Spain (World Trade Center Office)

Schedule:
3 days in-office / 2 days work-from-home

Package:
€23,876 base salary + €3,408 performance bonus

Relocation Assistance:
Direct flight booking to Barcelona and 30 days of private studio apartment accommodation fully sponsored

Position Summary

Working from Barcelona as a Google Ads consultant, you will act as a primary digital growth partner for growing companies operating in the Dutch market. You will take full ownership of client portfolio management—guaranteeing smooth onboarding processes, driving deeper product adoption, retaining accounts long-term, and pinpointing lucrative expansion avenues to support client business growth.

Primary Duties

Strategic Onboarding: Onboard new business accounts smoothly, identifying key objectives to formulate customized digital ad strategies.
Stakeholder Outreach: Connect regularly with high-level decision-makers to demonstrate campaign effectiveness and introduce suitable ad packages.
Campaign Optimization: Set up, monitor, and optimize Google Ads accounts while continually refining bid strategies, copy testing, and demographic parameters.
Analytics & Reporting: Interpret analytics data to formulate practical optimization recommendations that consistently maximize client ROAS.
Pipeline Management: Maintain thorough CRM records, logging every client communication and updating account progress stages.
Regional Feedback: Share observations regarding Dutch market developments and buyer behaviors to refine localized strategy models.

Applicant Profile

Language Skills: Fully fluent Dutch (C1/C2) paired with fluent business English capabilities.
Background: Background in client account management, B2B sales development, or digital media consulting using CRM platforms.
Cultural Context: Thorough familiarity with Dutch business norms, market dynamics, and GDPR compliance standards.
Core Strengths: Strong presentation capabilities, ease with marketing numbers and analytics, and fluency with modern digital tools.
Attributes: Highly goal-focused, proactive, and resilient in fast-moving, high-growth settings.

Offer & Perks

Contract: 39-hour full-time hybrid employment contract offering strong balance.
Relocation Package: Fully covered direct flight to Spain plus 30 days of dedicated private studio apartment housing provided free of charge.
Benefits: Private medical insurance taking effect immediately on your hire date.
Workplace: Seaside office location with coastal views, relaxed dress code, and frequent social gatherings.
Development: Clear internal learning pathways, personalized career coaching, and sponsored Google certifications.

Advancement Tracks

Senior Account Manager: Advance into managing enterprise accounts and strategic portfolios within your first year.
Team Lead: Move into management to lead daily operations, coach team members, and drive departmental goals.
Quality Analyst: Shift into quality control, focusing on campaign audits, policy enforcement, and operational standardization.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Sales and Business Development

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet
